name: make_voice_call
description: Call a phone number and deliver a spoken message: when they answer, the BlackBox voice agent says the message first and can then talk with them. For a call where the agent works through a task on your behalf, use make_phone_call instead.

phone_number.description: Phone number in E.164 format (e.g., +15551234567) or 10-digit US format

message.description: The message to speak. The voice agent says it as soon as the call connects.
